description: The exact text the account owner's wallet signs (EIP-191) to read or act on its factor account, and when the signature expires (five minutes). request: read, deposit, choose-factor, limits, pay, withdraw, exit, fire-factor, pause, outbox (read the house factor's sealed reviews), outbox-delete (with item, the envelope's name), activity (read its activity), alerts (subscribe: with destination, the webhook URL; rules; and nonce, new random hex), alerts-list (its subscriptions) or alerts-revoke (with id, a subscription's or "all", and nonce).

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

destination.description: alerts only: the webhook URL the alerts go to.

id.description: alerts-revoke only: the subscription's id, or all.

issued.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC time; now when left out.

nonce.description: alerts and alerts-revoke: 16 to 64 random lowercase hex characters, new for every request (it works once).

rules.description: alerts only: the rules, comma-separated (factorMoves, factorPayments, factorFees, factorWithdrawals, factorChanges).

name: account_request_message
title: Factor accounts: the text the owner signs
